tools.name: list_device_inventory
tools.summary: Expose a bounded read-only inventory of registered Kinex devices so a model can discover capabilities without scanning the workspace.

tools.name: inspect_episode_video
tools.summary: Inspect bounded, time-indexed video intervals as actual image attachments for post-evaluation diagnosis.
tested_tasks: robotwin/press-stapler-aloha-agilex (archived Iter3 and new Qwen3.8-Max integration validation)

tools.name: read_gripper_contract
tools.summary: Expose profile-declared gripper limits, geometry axes, mounting, TCP offset, and live aperture without model guesswork.

tools.name: verify_joint_arrival
tools.summary: Separate joint command acceptance/completion from measured arrival with explicit tolerance evidence.

tools.name: build_linear_contact_waypoints
tools.summary: Build arm-independent TCP waypoint variants for a straight surface-normal contact task.
tested_tasks: robotwin/press-stapler-aloha-agilex (geometry behavior preserved from harness_v2 iterations)

tools.name: check_joint_path_collision
tools.summary: Reject active-arm environment, non-adjacent self and stationary other-arm overlaps at joint-path samples.
tested_tasks: Synthetic rotated-box, self, stationary inter-arm and joint-path regression fixtures
Recorded turn-switch failed approach, offline public model replay; no new task success claim

tools.name: wait_for_joint_arrival
tools.summary: Poll feedback after non-blocking Servo until measured arrival, fault, or wall-clock timeout.
tested_tasks: robotwin/press-stapler-aloha-agilex (derived from harness_v2_iter_005; runtime validation pending next run)

tools.name: build_scene_collision_context
tools.summary: Build partial observed surface occupancy from registered depth and synchronized public robot geometry.

tools.name: solve_reachable_pose_sequence
tools.summary: Select complete chained-IK pose sequences with optional scoped arm/environment collision rejection.
